display_long_description:
This mixed reality app helps hairdressing trainees learn cutting techniques faster, safer, and with greater precision. By projecting virtual cutting lines directly onto the head of a model—whether a real person or a training mannequin—it creates an intuitive and highly practical training experience.

The app displays clearly visible guides, angles, and sections that are essential in professional haircutting. Trainees can follow these visual cues in real time, adjust their hand position, and practice each technique repeatedly until they master the movement.

The combination of real-world practice and digital guidance makes it easier to understand complex cutting patterns, identify mistakes early, and improve spatial awareness. Ideal for vocational schools, salons, and anyone looking to teach haircutting techniques efficiently and in a modern, hands-on way.

Notice: A QR Code containing any Link is Required for the App to function.
